# MSO official reading directory [繁體中文版 →](README.zh-Hant.md) **32 materials**, sorted by High → Medium → Low and recommended reading sequence within each level: 9 high, 19 medium, 4 low. Sort filenames in `EN/` or `TC/` and read in order. Filename format: `reading-order_priority_title (version)`, for example `03_High_…`. English and Chinese files with the same reading number refer to the same material. Priorities are study recommendations based on the official syllabus and document content, not published exam weights. High: first-pass essentials; Medium: second-pass reading or selected sections; Low: a final quick pass. Low does not mean unexaminable. Basis: Guidance Notes paragraphs 5.2-6.1. There are seven modules of five questions; passing requires at least three correct in every module and at least 25/35 overall. References include Cap. 615, the AML/CFT Guideline, Licensing Guide, other guidelines and circulars. [官方考試須知 / Official Guidance Notes](https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/download/licensing/Guidance_Notes_on_the_Competence_Assessment_for_Money_Service_Operators_zh_TW.pdf) ## High priority | Order | Material and local files | What it is | Reading focus | |---|---|---|---| | 01 | **Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Assessment rules and syllabus. | Read sections 5-7, passing rules and attendance arrangements first. | | 02 | **Competence Assessment - Sample Questions (12 May 2021) - MSSB/CA_01/2021**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Seven official sample questions. | Attempt first, understand every statement, then repeat after the core reading. | | 03 | **Guideline on AML-CFT for Money Service Operators (Jun 2023)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | The principal AML/CFT operating guideline for MSOs. | Study chapters 1-11 and Appendix A, including all control areas and remittance rules. | | 04 | **AMLO Cap 615 - Consolidated (24 Sep 2026)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | The statutory text of AMLO, Cap. 615. | Read Parts 1-7 and the Schedules; focus on MSO licensing, supervision, sanctions, review and Schedule 2. | | 05 | **Licensing Guide (May 2026)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Licensing, renewal and continuing operating requirements. | Read exemptions, procedures, premises, local management office, personnel and returns. | | 06 | **FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Official FAQs on AML/CFT and licence applications. | Read practical identity, ownership, representative and non-face-to-face cases alongside the current rules. | | 07 | **Circular - Supervisory Findings on Customer Due Diligence (22 Nov 2023) - MSSB/MIS_03/2023**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Supervisory findings on customer due diligence. | Read the deficiencies, expected standards and good practices for risk, ownership, screening and authority. | | 08 | **Circular - ML-TF Risks of Third Party Payments (17 Sep 2024) - MSSB/MIS_01/2024**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Risks and controls for third-party payments. | Study acceptance, approval, identity, relationships, funds, monitoring, records and reporting. | | 09 | **Circular - Identification and Mitigation of Proliferation Financing Risks (22 Dec 2021) - MSSB/MIS_06/2021** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Institutional proliferation-financing risk assessment and mitigation. | Read in full with guideline chapters 2 and 6, including review of existing business and customers. | ## Medium priority | Order | Material and local files | What it is | Reading focus | |---|---|---|---| | 10 | **Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Criteria for fitness and propriety. | Read with the supplement; distinguish adverse factors from automatic exclusions. | | 11 | **Supplementary Guideline on Fitness and Propriety (Jan 2020)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Supplementary fitness and propriety criteria. | Read competence, integrity, business intent, consumer interests and continuing compliance. | | 12 | **Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12-2019)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Required contents of a business plan. | Understand the business model, customers, jurisdictions, funds, staff, agents and outsourcing. | | 13 | **Guidelines for Submission of AML-CFT Policy (Ver 12-2019)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Required contents of an AML/CFT policy. | Use as a checklist for risk assessment, compliance, reporting, training, monitoring and audit. | | 14 | **Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Pecuniary penalties for licensing and operating breaches. | Read with AMLO sections 43 and 45; distinguish from disciplinary fining. | | 15 | **Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018)**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Disciplinary fining for specified AML/CFT breaches. | Read with sections 21 and 23: seriousness, deterrence, remediation, cooperation and history. | | 16 | **Circular - ML-TF Risks of Delivery Channels (13 Dec 2021) - MSSB/MIS_05/2021**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Risks arising from delivery channels and counterparties. | Read pre-engagement assessment, periodic review and suspicious transaction follow-up. | | 17 | **Circular - Cross-boundary Movement of Currency Ordinance Cap 629 (31 Jul 2018) - MSSB/MIS_06/2018**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Summary of cross-boundary currency and bearer instrument requirements. | Distinguish thresholds, arrival/departure, passengers and cargo. | | 18 | **Circular - E-submission of the Periodic Return (30 May 2025) - MSSB/MIS_02/2025**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Electronic periodic returns, reporting periods and data fields. | Study half-yearly submission, periods, electronic format and required fields. | | 19 | **Circular - Amendments to the Money Changers Ordinance Cap 34 (17 Nov 2025) - MSSB/MIS_04/2025**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Notice of amendments to the Money Changers Ordinance. | Read the notice, then the following statutory schedules. | | 20 | **Money Changers Ordinance Cap 34 - Schedules 2 and 3 - Official Webpage Extract (24 Aug 2025)** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Official webpage extract of Cap. 34 Schedules 2 and 3. | Read permitted statements and prescribed currencies, with sections 3-8 and Schedule 1 online for context. | | 21 | **Circular - Trade-based Money Laundering Guidance (20 Jan 2026) - MSSB/MIS_01/2026**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Trade-based money laundering risks and controls. | Read customer/funds checks, alerts, analysis and reporting, then the risk indicators. | | 22 | **Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators - FATF and Egmont (Mar 2021)** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Joint FATF/Egmont trade-based money laundering risk indicators. | Read the handling notes and four indicator groups; understand rather than memorise the lists. | | 23 | **Circular - Statements issued by the FATF (3 Jul 2026) - MSSB/FATF_02/2026**
[TC]() · [EN]() | FATF statements on high-risk and monitored jurisdictions. | Learn the different responses and check for a newer statement before the exam. | | 24 | **Circular - Publication of Hong Kong Risk Assessment Report (11 Jul 2022) - MSSB/MIS_06/2022** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | C&ED circular on the Hong Kong risk assessment report. | Read this short notice before the report to understand its application to MSOs. | | 25 | **Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022)** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Hong Kong territory-wide and sectoral risk assessment. | Focus on section 5.4 and MSO cases; selectively read TF and PF chapters. | | 26 | **Circular - United Nations Sanctions - Principles and Early Alerts (7 Feb 2018) - MSSB/SAN_01/2018** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Principles of UN sanctions screening and early alerts. | Read alongside guideline chapter 6, including sanctions not yet implemented locally. | | 27 | **Training Slides - Suspicious Transaction Reporting (Uploaded 7 Jan 2026)** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Officially hosted training slides on suspicious transaction reporting. | Use the cases and reporting explanation as an aid, not an independent exam specification. | | 28 | **Training Slides - ML-TF-PF Risk Assessment and Mitigation (12 Mar 2024)** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | C&ED training slides on ML/TF/PF risk assessment and mitigation. | Use diagrams and examples to consolidate the methodology; check current rules for detail. | ## Low priority | Order | Material and local files | What it is | Reading focus | |---|---|---|---| | 29 | **Circular - ML-TF Institutional Risk Assessment (13 Aug 2018) - MSSB/MIS_07/2018** **Added**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Earlier circular on institutional ML/TF risk assessment. | Read once alongside guideline chapter 2 and the delivery-channel circular; much overlaps. | | 30 | **Circular - Fraudulent Websites and Social Media Platforms related to MSOs (24 Apr 2025) - MSSB/MIS_01/2025**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Warning about fraudulent websites and social media impersonation. | Remember data protection, vigilance, public notification and reporting. | | 31 | **Circular - E-form Submission for Passenger Information on Currency and BNIs (23 Jun 2025) - MSSB/MIS_03/2025**
[TC]() · [EN]() | Passenger e-form and QR-code workflow for currency declarations. | Distinguish pre-filling from completing the declaration in person. | | 32 | **Circular - FATF Consultation on Payment Transparency Guidance (16 Jul 2026) - MSSB/FATF_03/2026**
[TC]() · [EN]() | FATF consultation on payment transparency guidance. | Understand the topic and future direction; do not treat a draft as current Hong Kong law. | ## Editions, languages and scope - The original 23 sources are retained unchanged; nine materials have been added, including the recommended additions, the earlier institutional risk assessment circular and two training decks. - **Item 20** is a text extract of Cap. 34 Schedules 2 and 3 from the official webpage, not the complete Ordinance or a verified PDF. The browser showed version 24 August 2025 on 18 October 2026; the PDF could not be saved. The extract links to the full law and identifies sections 3-8 and Schedule 1 for context. - **Item 22** contains the official English FATF/Egmont PDF downloaded from co-publisher Egmont Group. Its TC file is a reading pointer, not a Chinese translation. The direct FATF download returned 403. - **Item 27** was uploaded in both languages on 7 January 2026, but the official portal lists different seminar dates: 14 November 2025 for Chinese and 9 December 2025 for English. These are retained as their respective official editions, not described as verbatim translations of one seminar. - **Item 28** is dated 12 March 2024 and was uploaded on 12 April 2024. - **Item 04**, Cap. 615, retains the archived consolidated edition dated 24 September 2026. Whether it is still the latest edition was not reverified in this reorganisation. - Recheck current lists and periodic statements before the exam. Retain still-cited principles circulars; overlap with later guidance does not itself establish formal withdrawal. - The current bank and revision pack still use the original 23 sources. Archiving the nine additions does not establish question-bank coverage of them. Training decks are reading aids, not an additional official syllabus. ## Official sources The document number is its reading order, filename prefix and number used in quotes and extracted text. | # MSO 官方資料閱讀目錄 [English version →](README.md) 共 **32 項材料**，按「高 → 中 → 低」及同級建議閱讀順序排列：高9項、中19項、低4項。在 `TC/` 或 `EN/` 按檔名排序，順次閱讀即可。 檔名格式：`閱讀序號_優先級_文件名稱（版本）`，例如 `03_高_…`。同一序號的中英文檔案對應同一材料。 優先級是根據官方考綱及文件內容作出的復習建議，並非海關公布的出題權重。高：第一輪重點讀；中：第二輪完整讀或按建議選讀；低：最後快速讀。低優先級不表示不會考。 官方依據：《能力評核須知》第5.2至6.1段。七個單元各5題；每單元至少答對3題，總分至少25/35。參考類別包括第615章、反洗錢指引、牌照指引、其他指引及通函。 [官方考試須知 / Official Guidance Notes](https://eservices.customs.gov.hk/MSOS/download/licensing/Guidance_Notes_on_the_Competence_Assessment_for_Money_Service_Operators_zh_TW.pdf) ## 高優先級 | 順序 | 材料及本地檔案 | 它是甚麼 | 閱讀重點 | |---|---|---|---| | 01 | **能力評核須知（2022年12月）**
